data.heading: Devanhaar Projects
data.description: Devanhaar is dedicated to inspiring individuals on their spiritual journey. We take a holistic approach to engage members at every stage of life, offering guidance, learning opportunities, and community support to nurture personal growth, development, and connection to Sikh values.

items.title: Singhs Camps
items.description: The first UK & Europe retreats exclusively for Male Adult Sikhs at any stage of their spiritual journey.

items.title: Kaurs Camps
items.description: An everlasting sisterhood, grounded in a yearly retreat, with the aim of connecting sangat to spiritual growth, shared learning, and a supportive community.

items.title: Kids Camps
items.description: Bespoke camps around the UK that are tailored to engage with youth in an interactive, fun and memorable way.

items.title: Sikh Family Initiative
items.description: Bringing families together through retreats, shared experiences and community events, with Sikhi at the heart of everything we do.

items.title: Sikhi Vidyala
items.description: An educational institution providing knowledge on Sikh history, philosophy and teachings. Originally started by Bhai Jagraj Singh.

items.title: University Projects
items.description: Uni Talk Series crisscrossing the UK, delving into 'The Essence of Sikhi' and supporting Sikh students at a defining time.

items.title: Gurmat Academy
items.description: A space for young students to develop their Sikhi through Gurbani Santhiya, Ithihaas, philosophy and Seva.

items.title: Self Defence Academy
items.description: An academy dedicated to nurturing strength, skill and confidence whilst being rooted in Sikh values of honour, integrity and discipline.

items.title: Sikh Professional Network
items.description: A platform connecting Sikh professionals across industries for mentorship, career development, and collaborative growth.

data.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
data.subheading: Find answers to common questions below

items.question: What is Devanhaar?
items.answer: Devanhaar is a UK-based Sikh charity that empowers young Sikhs through educational camps, university talks, Gurmat academies, and community-building projects. Our mission is to develop, empower, elevate and connect.

items.question: How can I get involved with Devanhaar?
items.answer: There are many ways to contribute — you can volunteer as a sevadaar at our camps, attend our university talks, enrol in Sikhi Vidyala, donate to support our projects, or simply spread the word to your Sangat.

items.question: Are Devanhaar events open to everyone?
items.answer: Yes, our events and projects are open to all Sikhs regardless of background, experience, or level of practice. We create inclusive, welcoming spaces for everyone on their journey.

items.question: How are donations used?
items.answer: Every donation directly supports our projects — from Singhs Camps and university programmes to Sikhi Vidyala and community outreach. We are transparent about how funds are allocated across our projects.

items.question: Where is Devanhaar based?
items.answer: Devanhaar is a registered UK-based charity. We run projects across the UK, with camps, talks and programmes held at various locations nationwide.
